children: US used car dealer's fiscal Q1 revenue fell 57% yr/yr as inventory shrank sharply
Company attributed declines to capital constraints, not demand, and ongoing strategic review
Company says resolving capital structure remains its first priority
CAPITAL CONSTRAINTS - Co said limited capacity to purchase inventory and fund originations drove sharp declines in retail units sold and revenue
INVENTORY REDUCTION - Inventory drawdown and dealership consolidations reduced vehicles available for sale, further limiting sales volume
WEAKER CREDIT PERFORMANCE - Net charge-offs and delinquencies rose due to portfolio contraction, customer cost pressures, and transition to centralized collections
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the auto vehicles, parts & service retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for America's CAR-MART Inc is $7.50, about 201.2% above its September 8 closing price of $2.49
